normalizedOutcome: An operator on an unconverged story runs proof-or-stop done_required_validate and sees [pre_cert_window_required] before any root npm test starts. After inventory finalize, merge main, and a clean tree, certification_window_begin prints State: ADMITTED. A source commit inside that window makes status print State: INVALIDATED and Next: story_advance --phase=REVIEW.
acceptanceClaim: Official heavy certification cannot start without a current ADMITTED CertificationWindow, and a source mutation cannot keep old receipts as PASS.
